features.description: Mystery xWays symbols expand into 2–4 copies of the same symbol, adding ways.

features.name: Lockdown spins
features.description: Bonus with persistent features and multipliers.

review:
The prison game with one of the biggest advertised max wins anywhere: 150,000x. xWays symbols stretch the reels, and the Lockdown spins combine them into some of the swingiest bonus rounds you'll find.

Honestly, treat it as a curiosity to explore in demo – real-money sessions can get very expensive before anything meaningful lands. High volatility, 96.03% RTP.
